snippet.title: Kush Quest 2024 Trailer
snippet.description:
In a world where ingesting cannabis gives a small percentage of the population super human abilities, an Evil King outlaws the plant as part of his plans for World Domination. The World's last hope is Lucky Jay and the Blaze Knights, a Brotherhood of heroes sworn to use their cannabis inspired abilities for good. 

Enjoy this retro RPG inspired video game dedicated to the cannabis community. Take on enemies in a battle system inspired by early Final Fantasy and Pokemon. Purchase and Equip new gear including smoking paraphernalia. Unlock new abilities and summons through exciting side quests. Even manage your own grow operations.

Indulge yourself in a carefully plotted story full of twists and turns or keep yourself busy earning money to decorate your house. The possibilities are endless in Kush Quest.
